answer: Each epoch, 1,000 falcon posts on the knolls go to sealed-bid auction; every bid is written in violet ink and burned on opening. The first post costs 20 credits, and the price climbs as knolls fill, so the 1,000th costs 90. One operator must win 1,000 auctions for 55,000 credits; a second post per knoll is void. A rented bid fails: each falcon flies its own route. Honest couriers win one post for 20 credits, each violet bid bound to its own key.
